title: Users That Actively Request Confirmation Messages
goal: Find users with two confirmation requests no more than twenty-four hours apart.
strategy: Sort requests within each user and compare adjacent timestamps. Any close pair implies a close adjacent pair; confirmation outcome does not affect the time-window condition.

phasePurposes.start: Find users with two confirmation requests no more than twenty-four hours apart.

edgeCases: Exactly one day qualifies regardless of action
One second beyond a day does not qualify
Registered users with no confirmation requests
inputRules: The input parser enforces the problem domain and explicit limits for an inspectable trace.
